title: Sethite theory adopted by Jews and by the church through Augustine
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Sethite theory adopted by Jews and by the church through Augustine, about 2nd century AD onward at Jewish community and early church, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: verse. And and what they did was uh they said that the the sons of God in Genesis 6 that that populated with the daughters of Adam that these were noble men from the line of Seth

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about a passage in Genesis 6, the part of the Bible where the 'sons of God' have children with human women. He says Jewish teachers, and later the Christian church through the early theologian Augustine, explained these 'sons of God' as noble men from the family line of Seth, Adam's son. He tells it because, in his view, this reading steered people away from seeing those beings as something other than human.
